Body.Content:
Keep meetings on track with a shared countdown timer in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows. Start, pause, resume, or cancel a timer from the room’s touch console, with the countdown visible on the front-of-room display and in participants’ meeting views. Available with a Teams Rooms Pro license.

GA date: January CY2027
